paper.title: Fast and Sample Efficient Multi-Task Representation Learning in Stochastic Contextual Bandits

settings.name_in_paper: Multi-task representation learning in linear contextual bandits with low-rank structure
unmapped: Multi-task: N_tasks linear contextual bandit tasks played simultaneously for T rounds; parameter matrix Theta* = B* W* of rank r shared across tasks
Feature vectors phi(x_{n,t}, c_{n,t}) assumed i.i.d. standard Gaussian (Gaussian design)
Incoherence of right singular vectors: ||w_t*||^2 <= mu^2 (r/N_tasks) sigma_max^2
The learner uses knowledge of kappa, mu and sigma_max (step size gamma = 0.4/sigma_max^2, truncation constant 9 kappa^2 mu^2)

results.notes: Paper's N (rounds) mapped to canonical T; paper's T (tasks) declared as N_tasks. Regret is defined through expected rewards (pseudo-regret) but the bound holds with probability 1-delta-Ld^{-10}, hence high_probability_regret. Per-epoch Lemma C.1 (with an extra max(eps,eps_noise) factor) not recorded separately. Proof's correctness is questionable (uses Gaussian design for greedy-selected features).
